questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: Asking a stranger's name politely
questions.learningObjective: Explain how to ask a stranger's name in an elevator
questions.stem: In the elevator, how do you ask a stranger's name politely?

answer.exemplar: Bonjour, excusez-moi, je ne crois pas vous connaître ; comment vous appelez-vous ? Je suis l'hôte de la réunion.

questions.explanation: Polite requests use 'vous' and an apology. Informal or direct forms breach etiquette. The exemplar respects distance.
questions.hint: Apologize and use vous.
